# lab log

<!-- Generated by `lab docs` from the commands' own help (cli/build.sh). Do not edit by hand:
     change the command's help text in cli/ and rebuild. -->

```text
Log one result to MLflow (tuning/log_run.py in the MLflow image) from the current folder, then send the
phone notification with Rerun/Skip/Open buttons. Same MLflow fields as tuning/log.
Settings read from the environment: SERIES, SKILL_NAME, SKILL_SHA, RUN_START (adds live_* speed from
llama-swap's request log), NOTIFY=0 (no notification), MLFLOW_URL (tests only: another MLflow).
Good result: "Logged run <id>" and a notification "Done: <model> (<machine>)".
```

Usage:

```
lab log <machine> <model> <note> [name=value ...] [files ...]
```
